actors.name: Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee
actors.private_context: The committee is aware of the rail franchise bill and the sixty-day window for scheduling a public hearing. The committee chair has discretion over scheduling, but members may have varying opinions on the bill.

shared_context: The rail franchise bill has been introduced in the Republic of Valdoria's parliament. The transport committee's rules allow a sixty-day window from the bill's referral to schedule a public hearing. The bill was referred to the committee on 2026-08-01, so the window closes on 2026-09-30. No hearing has been scheduled yet.

starting_events.description: The rail franchise bill is referred to the parliamentary transport committee, starting the sixty-day window for scheduling a public hearing.
visible_to: Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the committee scheduled a public hearing on the rail franchise bill on or before 2026-09-30T18:00:00+03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
